name: tzdb_path
title: Retrieve the path to the time zone database

origin.description: Return the path to the time zone database.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: The kind of database. Only "text" is accepted.

origin.details: The text database is the tzdata directory installed with the package. Any other type stops with "`type` must be 'text'.".

translation.description: Return the directory of the text time zone database.
translation.details: The files are taken from cran/contrib/tzdb_0.5.0.tar.gz and kept in a cache directory. The absolute path is that cache, so it differs from R's library path. The proof compares the error for a bad type, the version file, and the file list.
translation.value: The database directory as a string.
